title: Page 8
content_zh:
哼，那也是他自作孽，活该！
“瑞儿，我买了虾子，等一会儿我再炒虾子给你吃，现在，让我先睡一下。”他双手圈住她的腰，喃喃低语，“两天没抱到你，我好想你。”
没有任何喜悦，倒有一丝愤怒。如果此刻坐在她这位子的人换成是夏春静，他应该也会对她说同样的话。
回头，她端出温柔似水的笑容。“尚仁，你看起来好累，你先睡一觉，我去煮虾子，等你睡醒就可以吃了。”
原本已闭上眼的他，忽地睁开一只眼，狐疑地问：“你会煮？”
“我的厨艺很普通，但是为了亲爱的你，我会加油的。”说着，她还温柔的帮他盖被。“最近天气变冷了，小心别着凉了。”
话语甫落，人已经飘走。
明明她笑得很温柔，为什么他感觉脚底发麻，一路麻到头顶？说也奇怪，才两天不见，瑞儿竟变这么温柔，害他熊熊很不习惯。
莞尔，眼一阖，他累得马上睡着。
穿着围裙的巴瑞儿，站在炉火前，手中拿着一瓶柠檬汁，发狠地将整瓶柠檬汁全倒入锅中，酸辣汤块放了几块也不知，反正一整盒都空了。
今天，她要煮一锅超酸超辣的泰式酸辣虾汤，酸死掌尚仁、辣死掌尚仁！
怪她没骨气，没办法说走就走，见他累坏的模样，她还于心不忍，不忍逼他马上做决定。
会累是吧？等他吃了这一锅无敌酸辣虾汤，保证他神清气爽，精神百倍，精气神亢奋到想睡都睡不着。
令她更气的是，方才她去敲客房的门，夏春静居然不在，她忍了她足足两天，为的就是等尚仁回来，大家面对面说清楚。
现在尚仁回来了，她居然走了？！那她忍她两天的痛苦，是在忍假的喔！
哼，该不会他们两个事先联络过，他回来之前，她就离开……
“瑞儿，你在煮什么？”掌尚仁突然从后头给她一个熊抱，差点把她的魂给吓飞。
“你干么不出声，想吓死我呀！”
“吓到你了？我向你赔罪。”他快速地在她两颊各亲一下。
都什么时候了，他还有心情玩亲亲！

不过，他如果真想玩，她就陪他玩。
“尚仁，你怎么不多睡，会儿？你才睡半个小时而已。”她不自觉地学起夏春静和他通电话时的嗲声嗲气。
天气应该还不算冷，他怎么突然打了个冷颤？
“我闻到香味，一股又酸又辣时味道，所以想来看看你在煮什么。”
“我在煮泰式酸辣虾汤，不知道你喜不喜欢吃？”
“我喜欢，只要有虾子的料理，我都喜欢。”
“可是，这是人家第一次煮耶……”水汪汪的眼睛直盯着他，眼神充满期待又怕受伤害。
“看起来很不错。”他主动帮忙把锅子端到餐桌上，嗅了嗅。“哇，味道好浓，一定很够味。”
没错，保证够味，铁定辣死你、酸死你。
“尚仁，来，碗筷给你，快吃吃看。”她佯装贤慧的拿了一副碗筷，摆在他面前。
“你不吃？”为什么他总感觉有哪里不对劲？
“我今天好像有点过敏，手跟脚都有点痒，我还是别吃虾子，免得更严重。”她微笑地献殷勤。“来，我帮你盛汤。”
替他盛了满满一大碗的虾子，手肘抵在桌面，手心托住下颚，她又用水汪汪的
大眼看着他。
“尚仁，你快点吃嘛！”
“好，我吃，我吃。”他无法招架漂亮女人用可爱的表情望着他，那两颗水汪汪的大眼一闪一闪发出光芒，眼前的瑞儿像是梦幻少女。
剥了虾壳，在她眼睁睁的期盼注视下，他张大嘴，把肉质鲜美的虾肉送入嘴里，哇，怎么会超级重酸又重辣，辣到他嘴都麻了！
“是不是不好吃？”柳眉微蹙，她佯装自责，一脸欲哭样。“那你别吃了，我把它拿去倒掉，再去买新鲜虾子回来让你自己煮。”
眼看佳人含泪欲滴，尽管嘴辣到发麻，再酸再辣，他都得吞下。“不，很……很好吃，这是我吃过最……最够味的泰式酸辣虾汤。”
“真的？你喜欢？”

“我……我喜欢。”
“那多吃点。”
“好，不过，可不可以先给我一杯水？”他苦笑。
如果他不认识瑞儿，光看她的表情，他会真的以为她是一个天真无邪又可爱的小女人，但是偏偏她的底，他早在亿万年前就摸透了。
没意外的话，一定是他在什么地方得罪她，所以她要用这么极酸极辣的方式惩罚他。
“水啊？矿泉水都喝光了，昨天到现在我都没出门，所以没买水耶。”她眼睛带笑，甜甜地说：“尚仁，你渴的话，喝汤，这汤应该很好喝。”望着眼前碗里红通通的汤，掌尚仁一脸哭笑不得。
“我帮你拿另外一个碗来盛汤。”
她拿另一个空碗来盛汤时，他的手机突然响起。
“瑞儿，我先接个电话。”接起电话，他逃命似的往客厅大步走去。
帮掌尚仁盛汤时，巴瑞儿很是好奇自己煮的这碗汤到底辣到什么程度？趁他去接电话时，她偷偷拿了小汤匙，弄一点点汤喝，才舔了一下，舌尖立刻辣得发麻，她一个箭步跑到垃圾桶边吐口水，然后蹲下身，一口气喝掉半瓶水。
怎么会这么辣？自己干么笨到好奇去尝汤，真是猪不肥肥到狗，明明是要辣死他的，却反倒辣到自己。
可是，知道虾汤这么辣，根本无法入口，她顿时犹豫起来，不忍心再逼他喝。“瑞儿……呃，你在做什么？”
“没有。”把矿泉水瓶丢进柜子里，关上柜门，她若无其事站起身。“我只是在看里头有什么东西。”
“喔。那你慢慢看，公司有事我必须立刻过去一趟，至于这锅虾汤……晚一点我回来时再吃。”他真的有要紧的事必须立刻出门，不是想逃避她的“惩罚”。“如果你有话要对我说，晚上等我回来，我一定听你说，OK？”
语落，他急匆匆出门。
又来了！她都还没机会开口询问他和夏春静的事，他就溜了。
挂她电话、避不回来、回来马上又溜……
她如果再同情他，她巴瑞儿就是猪头！
气腾腾地坐在餐桌前，她又气又恼，自己心软个什么呀，管他累不累，他一回来她就该马上揪着他的领口质问他，然后一拳揍昏他，让他哪里都去不了，只能待在屋里，“专心”解决他们三人的事。
气、气、气……

一边生气，一边剥虾壳，气到差点把虾子送入嘴里，还好她突然回复理智，急时踩煞车。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
晚上他回来，她绝对要让他辣到跪地求饶！
下午，睡到头昏脑胀的巴瑞儿起床后，一心惦记着那锅酸辣虾汤，迷迷糊糊的走向厨房，经过厕所，似乎听见里头有声音，她下意识地想开门察看，门竟然是锁着的。
“谁在里面？”该不会是尚仁回来，不敢到主卧房的洗手间怕惊醒她，所以只好到客房旁的这间洗手间？
没人应声，可是门是锁着，而且里头的人似乎踢到什么东西，发出很大的声响。
“掌尚仁，你在里面吗？”她两手环胸，沉声问。
“对啦、对啦，是我跟尚仁哥在里面，我们很忙，你不要在外面鬼吼鬼叫的好不好！”
夏春静！这女人怎么又回来了？而且，她居然跟掌尚仁在里面！
content_en:
Humph, that was his own fault, and he deserves it!
"Rui'er, I bought shrimps. I'll fry them for you later. Now, let me take a nap first." He put his hands around her waist and murmured, "I haven't held you in my arms for two days. I miss you so much."
There was no joy, but a hint of anger. If the person sitting in her seat at this moment was Xia Chunjing, he would probably say the same thing to her.
Looking back, she gave a gentle smile. "Shangren, you look so tired. You go to sleep first, and I'll cook the shrimps. You can eat them when you wake up."
He had already closed his eyes, but suddenly opened one and asked suspiciously, "Can you cook?"
"My cooking skills are mediocre, but for you, my dear, I will work hard." As she said that, she gently covered him with quilt. "The weather has gotten cold recently, be careful not to catch a cold."
As soon as the words were spoken, the person had already drifted away.
She obviously smiled softly, but why did he feel numbness in the soles of his feet, all the way to the top of his head? It was strange to say that after only two days of seeing each other, Rui'er had become so gentle, which made Xiong Xiong very uncomfortable.
Smiling, he closed his eyes and fell asleep immediately from exhaustion.
Barrier, wearing an apron, stood in front of the fire, holding a bottle of lemon juice in his hand. He poured the entire bottle of lemon juice into the pot, and he didn't know how many hot and sour soup cubes he put in. Anyway, the whole box was empty.
Today, she is going to cook a pot of Thai hot and sour shrimp soup that is so sour and spicy, so sour and spicy!
She blamed her for being spineless and couldn't just leave. Seeing how exhausted she was, she couldn't bear to force him to make a decision right away.
You'll be tired, right? After he eats this pot of invincible hot and sour shrimp soup, he is guaranteed to feel refreshed and energetic, and his energy will be so high that he can't sleep even if he wants to.
What made her even more angry was that when she knocked on the door of the guest room, Xia Chunjing was not there. She had tolerated her for two full days just to wait for Shang Ren to come back and everyone could explain it face to face.
Now that Shang Ren is back, she is actually gone? ! Then if she endured her pain for two days, she was just enduring it!
Humph, could it be that the two of them had contacted each other beforehand and she would leave before he came back...
"Rui'er, what are you cooking?" Zhang Shangren suddenly gave her a bear hug from behind, almost scaring her soul away.
"Why don't you say anything? You want to scare me to death!"
"Did I scare you? I apologize to you." He quickly kissed her on both cheeks.
It's been so long, and he's still in the mood for kissing!
However, if he really wanted to play, she would play with him.
"Shangren, why don't you sleep more, later? You only slept for half an hour." She unconsciously imitated Xia Chunjing's cooing voice when she talked to him on the phone.
The weather shouldn't be too cold yet, why did he suddenly shiver?
"I smelled something sour and spicy, so I wanted to see what you were cooking."
"I'm making Thai hot and sour shrimp soup. I wonder if you like it?"
"I like it, as long as there are shrimp dishes, I like it."
"But, this is my first time cooking..." Watery eyes stared straight at him, full of expectation and fear of being hurt.
"It looks good." He took the initiative to help bring the pot to the dining table and took a sniff. "Wow, the taste is so strong, it must be very tasty."
That's right, it's guaranteed to be delicious, and it'll definitely be spicy or sour to death.
"Shangren, come here, I'll give you the bowls and chopsticks. Come and eat." She pretended to be wise and took a pair of bowls and chopsticks and placed them in front of him.
"You don't want to eat?" Why does he always feel like something is wrong?
"I seem to have some allergies today, and my hands and feet are a little itchy. I'd better not eat shrimp to avoid getting worse." She smiled attentively. "Here, let me serve the soup for you."
She filled a large bowl of shrimps for him, resting her elbows on the table and supporting her chin with her palms.
Big eyes looked at him.
"Shangren, hurry up and eat!"
"Okay, I'll eat, I'll eat." He couldn't resist the beautiful woman looking at him with a lovely expression, those two watery eyesThe big eyes flashed and shone, and the Rui'er in front of her looked like a dreamy girl.
After peeling off the shells of the shrimp, he opened his mouth wide and put the delicious shrimp meat into his mouth as she stared at her expectantly. Wow, how could it be so sour and spicy that it made his mouth numb?
"Isn't it delicious?" Liu frowned slightly, pretending to blame herself and looking like she was about to cry. "Then don't eat it. I'll take it away and throw it away. Then I'll buy fresh shrimp and let you cook it yourself."
Seeing the beautiful woman burst into tears, he had to swallow it no matter how spicy it was to numbing his mouth, no matter how sour or spicy it was. "No, it's very... delicious. This is the most... delicious Thai spicy and sour shrimp soup I have ever tasted."
"Really? You like it?"
"I...I like it."
"Then eat more."
"Okay, but can you give me a glass of water first?" He smiled bitterly.
If he didn't know Rui'er, just by looking at her expression, he would really think that she was an innocent and cute little woman, but he had discovered her true nature hundreds of millions of years ago.
If there was no accident, he must have offended her somewhere, so she wanted to punish him in such a sour and spicy way.
"Water? All the mineral water has been drunk. I haven't gone out since yesterday, so I didn't buy water." With a smile in her eyes, she said sweetly: "Shangren, if you are thirsty, drink soup. This soup should be delicious." Looking at the red soup in the bowl in front of him, Zhang Shangren didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
"I'll get you another bowl for the soup."
As she reached for another empty bowl to serve the soup, his cell phone rang.
"Ruier, let me answer the phone first." After answering the phone, he strode towards the living room as if running for his life.
When helping Shang Ren serve the soup, Barrier was very curious about how spicy the bowl of soup she cooked was. While he was answering the phone, she secretly took a small spoon, made a little soup to drink, and then licked it. The tip of her tongue was immediately numb from the spicy food. She quickly ran to the trash can and spit, then squatted down and drank half the bottle of water in one breath.
Why is it so spicy? Why are you so stupid that you taste the soup out of curiosity? It's really like a pig is not as fat as a dog. It was obviously meant to kill him, but it only hurt yourself instead.
However, knowing that the shrimp soup was so spicy and impossible to eat, she immediately hesitated and couldn't bear to force him to drink it again. "Ruier...uh, what are you doing?"
"No." She threw the mineral water bottle into the cabinet, closed the cabinet door, and stood up as if nothing had happened. "I was just looking to see what was in there."
"Oh. Take your time, then. I have to go over there immediately if there is something going on at the company. As for this pot of shrimp soup... I'll eat it later when I come back." He really had something important to do and had to go out immediately, not because he wanted to escape her "punishment". "If you have something to say to me, I will definitely listen to you when I come back tonight, okay?"
After saying that, he hurried out.
here we go again! Before she had a chance to ask about him and Xia Chunjing, he slipped away.
Hang up her phone, can't avoid coming back, and run away as soon as she comes back...
If she sympathizes with him again, she, Barrel, will be like a pig!
Sitting angrily at the dining table, she was angry and annoyed. Why was she soft-hearted? No matter if he was tired or not, as soon as he came back, she should have grabbed him by the collar and questioned him, and then punched him unconscious so that he could not go anywhere and could only stay in the room and "concentrate" on solving the problems between the three of them.
Gas, gas, gas...
She was angry while peeling off the shrimp shells, so angry that she almost put the shrimps into her mouth. Fortunately, she suddenly regained her senses and stepped on the brakes in a hurry.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
When he comes back in the evening, she will definitely make him so hot that he kneels down and begs for mercy!
In the afternoon, after being dizzy from sleeping, Barrier woke up, thinking about the pot of hot and sour shrimp soup, and walked to the kitchen in a daze. Passing the toilet, she seemed to hear a sound inside. She subconsciously wanted to open the door to check, but it was locked.
"Who's in there?" Could it be that Shang Ren came back and didn't dare to go to the bathroom in the master bedroom for fear of waking her up, soHave to go to this bathroom next to the guest room?
No one answered, but the door was locked, and the person inside seemed to have kicked something, making a loud noise.
"Zhang Shangren, are you in there?" She crossed her arms and asked in a deep voice.
"Yes, yes, Brother Shang Ren and I are in there. We are very busy. Please don't yell and scream outside, okay?"
Xia Chunjing! Why is this woman back? Moreover, she was actually inside with Zhang Shangren!
